summary: register.com customers sign in at the Network Solutions Account Manager, and this entry shares that sign-in address. The host refuses automated reads: robots.txt and the sign-in page both answer HTTP 403 with a security check, and no other public source shows the form.

sources.title: The shared sign-in address, rendered once without an account for network-solutions: a challenge page, not the sign-in form
sources.note: Made for network-solutions before the capture standard was settled. Under that standard it would not have been made. It supports no selector and does not raise the class.

staysInteractive.note: A challenge page with a Cloudflare Turnstile widget stood in front of the sign-in page in the capture. Whether an ordinary visible browser is challenged too was not determined.

lookedFor: The catalog address is the one of network-solutions, so nothing was loaded for this entry. Everything recorded for network-solutions applies here unchanged.

robots.txt of www.networksolutions.com, read on the review date with a plain HTTP client: HTTP 403 and a page titled Security check | Network Solutions. A refused robots.txt means the check did not come back clean.
The capture made for network-solutions: HTTP 403 on the catalog host itself, a challenge card with a Cloudflare Turnstile frame; no form, no username field and no credential field.
Nothing specific to the register.com brand was looked for: the catalog sends both entries to the same page.
neededFromUser: The same as for network-solutions: the sign-in page saved from the user's own browser as "Webpage, Complete" and read with the capture tool's --from-file mode. One saved page serves both entries. Save any page signed out and with no password typed in; keep the "_files" folder beside the .html and both outside the repository: they can hold the account name.
notes: The cited capture was requested on www.networksolutions.com and ended on the same host and path. Whether it stays in the corpus is the lead's decision; if it is removed, this source entry goes with it.
